records.name: Jockey by TwelveLabs

records.name: CartAI
records.tagline: The AI agent that handles checkout.
records.description: Checkout is the hard part, and most solutions clear it only where the merchant has integrated. CartAI completes checkout on any live merchant surface with no merchant-side work, cooperating with bot detection instead of evading it. One developer-first API, four products: Catalog (search and live pricing across merchants), Checkouts (clear and track orders to confirmation), Payments (PCI off your stack via Visa and Mastercard agent rails), Monetization (commissions on every agent sale).

records.name: Topolines
records.tagline: Generate Topologic contours
records.description: Draw a zone, generate crisp topographic contour lines, and export print-ready SVG & HD PNG. Gradients, elevation taper and Figma-ready output.

records.name: Phantomstory
records.tagline: Launch a third-party blog to win AEO with just two clicks
records.description: Phantomstory helps teams win AEO by launching third-party blogs on fresh domains in under 5 minutes. With just two clicks, Phantomstory provisions credible content hubs that incrementally publish AI-search-ready articles. The secret? A portion of these expertly-written articles are designed to help LLMs discover, understand, and recommend your company. Stop thinking about AEO as just a monitoring problem; with Phantomstory, transform AEO into an actionable plan that actually drives results.

records.name: RegionMirror
records.tagline: Share a portion of your ultrawide or high-res screen on Mac
records.description: Define a region of your screen to be shared from your ultrawide or high resolution monitor, preventing the inevitable "can you zoom in?" that comes with sharing the entire screen. Define any size region to share, move apps in and out of the region seamlessly, resize the region on the fly, set a default region and invoke with a keyboard shortcut for quick and easy sharing. Blur for privacy. Scaled presenter view displays the content your viewers are seeing. Integrated annotations and whiteboard.

records.name: ditto.site
records.tagline: Clone any website into clean code. Free & open source
records.description: Point Ditto at any public URL and get a faithful copy as clean, componentized Next.js or Vite code, in minutes. It's fully deterministic, so it's fast, cheap, and consistent. Components, tokens, interactions & hover states included. Free REST API + MCP server, open source.

records.name: Manifest
records.tagline: Turn any webpage into an action manifest for AI agents
records.description: Manifest turns any webpage into a structured JSON map of what an AI agent can click, fill, and submit. One API call, no fragile selectors. Every action comes with resolved CSS/role locators, plus a requires field that encodes dependencies between elements (e.g. "select a plan before this button is clickable"). That's context aria snapshots don't give you. Python SDK, LangChain support, and an MCP server included. Built for anyone shipping browser agents.

records.name: DualStream
records.tagline: Simultaneous desktop and mobile streaming, the easy way.
records.description: Beautifully powerful streaming. Astonishingly easy. DualStream brings Desktop and Mobile audiences your content at the same time, from a single patent-pending engine. DualStream Relay carries your broadcast to every platform from our servers — and if your connection blinks, disconnection protection keeps your stream alive. Native Alerts, Per-Source audio control, VTuber support, instant replay clips, cinema grade effects, pop-out multi-platform chat and so much more is all built in.

records.name: Bolna Agent Studio
records.tagline: Build Voice AI Agent in 10 Minutes
records.description: Bolna's Agent Studio lets any business build and deploy a production-grade voice AI agent in minutes, no prompt engineering. Upload a doc or answer a few guided questions, and Studio assembles a call-ready agent from production-tested modules. Sign up and start calling on Day 0.

records.name: Universal Dictation on Stream
records.tagline: Private Voice Ring for dictation across iOS & Mac
records.description: Introducing Universal Dictation on Stream. Push-to-talk across iOS and Mac: Instantly. No app switching, no reconnection. We built Notes so nothing gets lost, and Chat so you can think out loud. With Dictation, your voice goes anywhere. Notes, Chat, Dictation—in one voice ring

records.name: OpenChatCut
records.tagline: Open-source AI agent video editor with a real timeline
records.description: OpenChatCut is an open-source ChatCut alternative: local-first AI video editing where Codex, Claude, and MCP agents work on a real multitrack timeline. Free, editable exports, AGPL.

records.name: Tidy
records.tagline: Your Mac tidies itself: screenshots, installers, Downloads
records.description: Tidy lives in your menu bar and handles three chores you keep doing by hand. It archives new Desktop screenshots, renaming them from their content with on-device OCR — "Screenshot 14.22.10.png" becomes "invoice-march.png". It ejects thedmg you mounted and trashes the installer. It sorts new Downloads by type, with rules you write in plain English. Apple Intelligence builds them on-device, so nothing leaves your Mac. Only touches new files. Never deletes. $9 once, no subscription.

records.name: Routine AI
records.tagline: Control work with your voice. The Siri for work.
records.description: Routine AI lets you control your tasks, calendar, notes and projects using your voice. Just talk naturally to schedule meetings, add reminders, capture ideas, write notes, search your knowledge, update projects and automate repetitive work.

records.name: Routebase
records.tagline: Catch API drift before your customers do
records.description: Your API lives in your design tool, your docs, your mocks, your tests, your monitoring — and every copy drifts. Routebase makes them one living source: change the spec, publish, and it catches what drifted. (Your AI agents read the same source over MCP.)

records.name: PieceKeeper
records.tagline: Track your music repertoire and practice
records.description: Never lose track of a piece again. PieceKeeper helps musicians manage their repertoire, run focused practice sessions based on a customized practice schedule, get insights and trends about their practice, and learn music theory through interactive drills and exercises aimed at improving both reading and listening skills.

records.name: CreateOS Sandbox
records.tagline: Instant, hardware Isolated Sandboxes for AI agents
records.description: CreateOS Sandbox gives AI agent builders their own fast, secure, hardware isolated, sandbox in ~30ms (p90). We have suit of CLI, SDK, 50+ SDK real world examples, claude plugins, computeSDK integration, and more

records.name: tterm
records.tagline: A terminal, a real browser, and Claude Code under one roof
records.description: tterm is a macOS cockpit for working with Claude Code. Every project is a row of explorer, Claude, and file viewer. Stack as many as you're juggling. A real Chromium browser lives inside, and there's no editor on purpose: you review diffs hunk by hunk and commit. It even rebuilds itself. Ask the Claude pane for a feature and the running app hot-reloads with it. No account, no telemetry. Free for hobbyists, on Apple silicon.

records.name: Rerun
records.tagline: The easiest way to build AI agents for all your tasks
records.description: Most AI agents are black boxes. Rerun isn't. Build no-code agents that run 24/7, chasing invoices, qualifying leads, clearing your inbox, and watch every step in real time. They pause for approval before anything sensitive. Each workspace gets its own private server. Start with the included model, or connect your own API key or subscription

records.name: Diffsmith
records.tagline: Comment on your AI agent's code & collaborate on changes
records.description: Diffsmith is a code review studio for local git changes made by Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, or any other AI coding agent. Open a repo, read the uncommitted diff, and click any line to leave a comment anchored to that exact spot. Then hand your notes straight back to the agent. Supports MCP for viewing you're agent's replies to your comments directly at the line of code it relates to. Diffsmith is 100% offline and a one time purchase unlocks lifetime access.

records.name: BUD
records.tagline: Voice-first canvas for sketchnoting and whiteboarding
records.description: Ideate, sketch, and edit diagrams in real time on a voice-first canvas. Speak naturally to build system architectures, flowcharts, and turn ideas into visuals.

records.name: MeetIsland
records.tagline: The Dynamic Island that gets you to meetings on time
records.description: MeetIsland turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island for meetings. Your next call lives quietly around the notch and expands with a live countdown and a one-click Join button (Meet/Zoom) right before it starts. Zero setup — it reads calendars already synced to macOS. $6.99 once, 14-day free trial.

records.name: ProtoFlow

The service is free to use, offers a full-suite platform, and exports smoothly to software like KiCad and Altium, allowing users at any skill level to fully optimize their hardware designs.

Everything competitors split across multiple paid tools, in one suite from $9/mo.

records.name: Fifty-Fifty Politics

It presents the strongest left and right arguments, side by side, on each of today's biggest political issues, with expandable explanations for every point. No ads, no accounts, no outrage, just the fastest way to understand why reasonable people disagree before forming your own opinion.

records.name: Word Presto

Coordinated by an AI Managing Editor, specialised AI workers analyse performance, identify opportunities, generate briefs, optimise content, and prepare multichannel publishing. Every recommendation is actionable, every change is reviewable, and nothing is published without human approval and editorial control.

Free, no signup, photos never stored.

Students can create one smart KARD for their resume, projects, skills, LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio, certifications, achievements, and contact details — then share it through one link or QR code. It is useful for internships, placements, hackathons, freelancing, college events, and networking. No paper card. No scattered links. Just KARD.

EU-hosted, files auto-deleted in 24h.

records.name: MerchReel
records.tagline: Shopify product videos in one click, no filming
records.description: Turn any Shopify product into a polished AI video ad in minutes. No filming, no editing software. One click per product, or bulk-generate your whole catalog. Outputs 9:16 for Reels, TikTok, and Stories, plus square and landscape versions for feed posts and product page embeds. 7-day free trial, no credit card required to start.

records.name: ML Studio
records.tagline: Machine Learning Model Building and Data Analysis Platform.
records.description: ML Studio provides machine learning model building solutions, pre-process the data, build the models and generates AI report. ML Studio provides advanced workflow solutions and deep learning model building. It has data visualization platform and dashboards with multiple layouts. Statistical analysis can be performed using ML Studio. We have recently added AI-enabled qualitative research platform.

records.name: browle
records.tagline: Find verified European alternatives to everyday US brands
records.description: browle is a trilingual (EN/DE/FR) directory of 631 brands genuinely made in Europe and Switzerland. Every listing links a public source proving where it's manufactured — because "European brand" and "made in Europe" are very different things. Search by the US product you want to replace, or browse 22 categories. Transparency cuts both ways: /not-listed documents famous names we checked but couldn't (yet) list — with sources and verified European alternatives.

records.name: pricemyrepair.co.uk
records.tagline: Enter your reg, get real repair prices for your exact car
records.description: Enter your reg and PriceMyRepair reads your car's MOT history, flags the repairs it predicts (urgent / soon / watch), and prices each one for your exact make and model — using official DVLA and DVSA data plus our repair-price database. Free, instant, no sign-up. Then compare live quotes from 18,000+ local garages. No more guessing what the garage will charge.

records.name: RGB Critter BT
records.tagline: One light. Whips, sabers, staffs, and 200+ glowing tools.

It works with or without the app once your modes are on the device. Launching on Product Hunt Tuesday, July 21. Follow to get notified the moment we go live.

records.name: Event Days to Now for Google Calendar
records.tagline: Countdown labels for every Google Calendar event
records.description: Event Days to Now adds tiny countdown labels (5h, 3d, 1y5d) before every Google Calendar event title — instantly see how soon or how long ago something happened. ✨ Features: • Countdown for future events, elapsed time for past ones • Customizable year/day/hour labels (e.g. 1年5天) • 13 popup languages, auto-detected • Pure CSS labels, real-time auto-updates • No data collection, privacy-friendly Great for deadlines, birthdays & meetings at a glance. Stop guessing and start scaling spend with clarity and conviction.

Download for Mac and Windows.

records.name: Melon Meter
records.tagline: Thump a watermelon. Your phone tells you if it's sweet.

Thump 3 times, tap its rough size, get a 1-10. Optionally photograph the field spot and it reads that patch's exact colour and the rind's webbing. It measures ripeness, which correlates with sweetness — a phone, not a lab. Rate one after cutting and the scale re-fits to your melons. Free, no signup.

records.description: Connect Jobing to ChatGPT, Claude, or another compatible AI app. Ask it to publish web pages, create custom forms, collect responses, and summarize what people submitted, while you keep control through drafts, permissions, and a dashboard.

records.name: SnapDuck
records.tagline: Download YouTube & TikTok videos in 4K without watermarks
records.description: Download YouTube & TikTok videos in 4K quality without watermarks. Fast, free, secure video downloader. No ads, no registration required. Support for multiple platforms. Crypto payments, playlist downloads with real-time progress, and more.

records.name: Improve My Ads
records.tagline: Identify barriers killing your ad conversion rates
records.description: Improve My Ads provides a behavioral-science audit for your advertisements. Simply upload text, screenshots, videos, or links to receive an analysis of your ad performance. The platform evaluates your content across six expert lenses, including copywriting, visual design, and conversion optimization. Users receive an overall score and initial findings for free. A full audit report is available for purchase, providing comprehensive insights, before-and-after copy rewrites, and a downloadable PDF.

records.name: PublishWizard Ultimate Edition
records.tagline: Automate your entire self-publishing workflow
records.description: Desktop suite that automates your entire self-publishing pipeline: formatting, cover validation, EPUB compliance checks, AI-assisted keyword research, royalty calculations, and licensing — in 5 languages. Built by an indie publisher tired of manual prep work across Amazon KDP, Google Play Books, and StreetLib. One-time payment, no subscription. Windows desktop app with a clean, modern interface designed for authors and small publishers managing multiple titles.

records.name: Caxton
records.tagline: The macOS editor for large files that break other editors
records.description: Native macOS editor for huge files. A 10 GB log opens instantly — memory-mapped, not loaded. Find 1.6M matches in 1.3s, Replace All in 1.7s, one undo. CSVs get a real grid: 2M rows, typed sorting, fill series. No Electron, no cloud, no telemetry.

records.name: Carteca
records.tagline: Your vehicle's health record
records.description: Carteca keeps your car and motorcycle's full service history, renewal reminders, parts health and running costs - in one beautifully simple app. The app allows you to keep receipts, deadlines and information about every major part system and repair history in one place. You can scan invoices, keep track of next maintenance milestones and share the vehicle with your family to have one source of truth about your fleet.

records.name: Equibles
records.tagline: MCP server for SEC filings, earnings calls & congress trades
records.description: An open-source MCP server that puts 1,000,000+ SEC filings and 100,000+ earnings-call transcripts inside Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini — every answer cited to the source filing, and engineered to refuse to guess. 90 tools + REST API over 5,000+ US stocks: filings, calls we capture and transcribe ourselves, company-specific KPIs read out of the filings (RPO, ARR, store counts), congress and insider trades, 13F, short data, macro. Free: 100 calls/day.

records.name: Smart Portfolio Manager (SPM)
records.tagline: Turn your resume + GitHub into a portfolio in 30 sec
records.description: Upload your resume pdf and SPM uses AI to pull your experience and skills, then syncs with your GitHub so you can pick your best repos. Get a shareable portfolio link in under 30 sec. Built this after losing time to updating my old portfolio every time I applied somewhere. Few themes right now, bento grid, macos window, terminal style. Still pretty new so resume parsing isnt perfect yet, would love feedback if you try it out.

records.name: Sited
records.tagline: Is your brand visible to AI?
records.description: Get a free AI Visibility infographic for your website. See how discoverable your brand is across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. Upgrade to a comprehensive $50 audit featuring six specialist AI agents analysing your brand's discoverability, citations, technical signals, content quality, competitive position, and prioritised recommendations. Receive a clear score, actionable fixes, and a roadmap to improve AI search visibility.

records.name: Supercool India
records.tagline: Air Cooler Manufacturer in india
records.description: Supercool is India's No. 1 air cooler manufacturer, delivering powerful, energy-efficient, and durable air cooling solutions for homes, businesses, and industries across the country

records.name: Nodl
records.tagline: Stop explaining your system , Show it.
records.description: IT documentation is walls of text describing systems nobody can picture. Nodl turns your whole IT landscape into a living map: every system, the integrations and databases they share, and the changes that shaped them. Click anything to see everything connected to it, or just ask Canvas AI and it takes you straight to the answer. AI builds your first map from a CSV or Jira export, and a "nodl" label in Jira sends finished work to the canvas. Nothing lands without your review.

records.name: Wably
records.tagline: The AI on WhatsApp that answers and books appointments
records.description: Wably is an AI powered WhatsApp assistant that automates appointment booking, customer support, reminders, rescheduling, and follow ups. Customers simply chat on WhatsApp while Wably answers questions, manages availability in real time, updates calendars, saves new contacts automatically, and requests reviews after appointments. It helps service businesses reduce administrative work, minimize no shows, and deliver a better customer experience 24/7.

records.name: WebKarigar
records.tagline: Stop pitching. Start showing.
records.description: Stop pitching. Start showing. WebKarigar helps freelancers, agencies, and web developers close clients by generating personalized websites for business leads before sending outreach.

records.name: LUFS Converter Pro
records.tagline: Batch convert & normalize audio loudness offline.
records.description: LUFS Converter Pro is a lightweight, offline Windows utility designed for fast batch audio loudness normalization. Unlike online converters, it processes your files 100% locally with absolute privacy and zero speed throttles. Easily adjust target LUFS levels for streaming platforms, podcasts, or music archives without needing complex DAW software. Key features: Fast batch processing, full privacy (no cloud required), clean UI, and simple one-click operations.

records.name: Magpie
records.tagline: Keep the shiny things - private moodboards in your browser
records.description: Magpie is a quiet side-panel collector for images, screenshots, links & snippets — organized into boards, saved as files on your machine, synced across devices if you choose.

records.name: Arborist
records.tagline: A macOS command center for git worktrees
records.description: Arborist is an app for macOS which helps you keep your git projects in order. You can launch the tools you always use into the correct context, and run commands no matter which worktree you're in. AI workflows are especially helped because you can see your Claude and Codex chats right in the inspector pane. Take control of your git projects with Arborist.

records.name: Jyotir AI
records.tagline: Free AI Vedic kundli chat from your real birth chart
records.description: Most AI astrology apps invent vibes from a sun sign. Jyotir AI computes your real Vedic birth chart (Swiss Ephemeris), then lets you chat in plain language about career, marriage, dashas, doshas, yogas, and timing—grounded in that chart. Free daily chat. Optional paid full PDF Kundli report. Built for people who want accuracy, not horoscope fluff. Works on mobile. No app install. Just birth details → chart → ask.

records.name: Haunted Random Universe
records.tagline: A haunted world of random generators and fun tools
records.description: Haunted Random Universe is a spooky-themed collection of random generators and decision-making tools wrapped in a dark fantasy experience. Instead of a plain utility website, every tool is presented inside a haunted universe with immersive visuals, animations, and atmospheric design. From Spin the Wheel, Password Generator, and Dice Roller to Movie Picker, Food Picker, and Truth or Dare, every visit feels like exploring a mysterious digital world.

records.name: RadioDock
records.tagline: Free Cross-Platform Community Radio Player
records.description: Listen to 50K+ online and local radio stations worldwide. Free player and list manager for web, browser extension, desktop, and mobile.

records.name: Centsible Subscription Tracker
records.tagline: Centsible is made for who don't have time for cancellations.
records.description: Tired of losing your hard-earned money to forgotten, sneaky subscriptions? Corporate giants (Goliaths) make subscribing incredibly easy while turning cancellation into a nightmare. Centsible is your slingshot. We're here to help you take back control of your finances, track your billing cycles, and effortlessly terminate unwanted subscriptions. Centsible is made for who don't have time to navigate the cancellation labyrinth. We don't just track your spending; we act as your personal protector.

records.name: Life Tile
records.tagline: Track Your Time, See Your Day
records.description: Life Tile tracks where you spend your time and shows your day as a Mondrian-style tile grid. What makes it different: * Square tiles + treemap that stay readable with many categories * Fully on-device. No accounts, no servers, no ads * One-time purchase, no subscription * Import your data from other time trackers via CSV * Widgets, Shortcuts, and Apple Health (sleep + workouts) Built for people who want to see where their time actually goes, without handing their location history to a server.

records.name: NeuroSprint — The daily brain benchmark
records.tagline: A daily 6-minute brain benchmark you race with friends
records.description: Three brain-training events, two minutes each, every day. Everyone plays the same daily challenge, so your Brain Score comes with a real top-% rank against everyone who played today — not a score in a vacuum. When you finish, you get an emoji grid to share (think Wordle) and can challenge a friend to beat it. No signup to try. Built for people who bounce off single-player brain apps and want a reason to come back daily.

records.name: Reset Music
records.tagline: Share Your Music With Fans for independent artists
records.description: Reset Music is a next-generation streaming and distribution platform tailored for ambient, instrumental, and experimental creators. Unlike traditional platforms, we offer a dedicated ecosystem that empowers independent sound designers and musicians to seamlessly host, publish, and monetize their catalog under a subscription model. Built with high-quality streaming for listeners who value deep focus, sound art, and pure audio quality.

records.name: Agency OS
records.tagline: Run your entire agency from one Notion system
records.description: Agency OS is the complete Notion operating system for freelancers and micro-agencies: an 8-stage CRM, projects, tasks, branded client portals, invoicing with a follow-up cadence that gets you paid, meeting notes, and 6 pre-written SOP playbooks — all connected with working rollups. Ships with a realistic sample agency pre-loaded so you learn by exploring. Duplicate it, add your clients, and be live in under an hour. Works fully on Notion's free plan, including client portals.

records.name: SendnGrab — доставка через попутчиков
records.tagline: Travel & earn — deliver parcels on your way
records.description: Paid €60 to send an envelope. My friend flew the same route with an empty bag. SendnGrab connects people who need to send things with travelers already heading that way. 📦 Senders — find a traveler on your route, pay 3–4x less than couriers. ✈️ Travelers — take a package, earn €15–40 and offset your ticket. People already do this via Telegram. We made it searchable, organised and with verified profiles. Beta is free. Live in Europe.

records.name: Ruema
records.tagline: Remember anything. Just by talking.
records.description: Ruema is an AI memory companion that remembers what you tell it, so you never need folders, tags, or endless notes. Speak naturally, and months later ask in your own words. Ruema understands what you meant and finds the answer instantly. Your memories stay private, encrypted, and under your control. Remember anything. Just by talking.

records.name: SelectVideo
records.tagline: Find YouTube videos by topic, not by the algorithm
records.description: Browse curated YouTube videos in English, organized by categories. Quality long-form content updated daily.

records.name: Comparisec - Cyber Comparison Tool
records.tagline: Cybersecurity tools compared. Decisions simplified.
records.description: Comparisec is a comparison platform built for cybersecurity buyers overwhelmed by vendor noise. Compare MDR, CSPM, compliance, and GRC tools side by side, covering features, pricing, and certifications, all in one place. We cut through sales pitches to give you unbiased, practical insights so you can find the right security fit faster, whether you're a startup or a large enterprise.

records.name: Everkin Pet Health Journal
records.tagline: Your pet's whole story, always with you.
records.description: Most pet apps remember the last week. Everkin remembers the last years - the patterns that matter when your pet has a chronic condition. Log symptoms, weight, meals, and bathroom habits. Track glucose curves or seizures with duration, severity, and triggers. Your whole household shares it in real time. Give sitters scoped, auto-expiring access with a full activity log. Export a clean PDF for the vet in one tap. Free to start on iOS. Everkin+ unlocks the advanced tracking.

records.name: RaaDoc
records.tagline: Free PDF, image, Utilities & dev tools — nothing uploaded
records.description: RaaDoc is a free toolkit with more than 55 tools for PDFs, images, developers and everyday tasks. No sign-up, no daily limits, no watermarks. 52 of the 56 tools run entirely in your browser — files are processed locally and never touch a server.

records.name: Salah Clock
records.tagline: Prayer Times Display for Mosques, Homes & Offices
records.description: Put a beautiful, accurate prayer-time display on any TV. Real adhan audio, 18+ themes, 10 languages, works offline. Free for your masjid, home, office, or school — set up in 60 seconds.

records.name: Sleep Sounds, White Noise
records.tagline: Sleep Sounds, White Noise
records.description: Tired of sleepless nights? Fall asleep faster with calming rain, soothing nature sounds, gentle lullabies, and ambient white noise. Sleep Sounds is 100% free — no ads, no subscription, ever. Whether you're fighting insomnia, escaping a snoring partner, calming an anxious mind, or simply wanting to wake up refreshed, Sleep Sounds helps you drift off in minutes with a carefully crafted library of high-quality sounds designed for real rest.

records.name: Connect+ (Number Puzzle)
records.tagline: Every swipe is a mini mental-math workout
records.description: Connect+ is a free number-puzzle game where every swipe is a mini mental-math workout. Trace paths of numbers that add up, double your tiles, and beat your best. A colorful, family-friendly logic game for kids ages 10+. Play free in your browser or on Android.

records.name: CD Calculator
records.tagline: Calculate Your CD Earnings with Confidence. ⭐
records.description: Free CD Calculator with charts and accumulation schedule. Plus 70+ mortgage, retirement, loan, and investment calculators. No sign-up required.

records.name: Canvasthing
records.tagline: Artist Assistant App for Drawing & Painting
records.description: Canvasthing is an artist assistant app for working from reference images. It helps you plan a physical canvas by locking in your exact dimensions. You can add custom grids to map out the scale, generate a clean sketch outline to trace, or simplify complex details into basic color blocks so it's easier to paint. It also has a color inspector for mixing paint by eye. It's entirely free, has no ads, and doesn't require an account, just use it in your browser or install it.

records.name: Vai Anotando
records.tagline: Digital menu via WhatsApp. No app. No friction.
records.description: Restaurant owners in Brazil don't need an app — they need WhatsApp. VaiAnotando turns any menu into a WhatsApp experience. Customers scan a QR Code and browse the full digital menu instantly — no download, no new account needed. What makes it different: → Zero friction (WhatsApp is on 96% of Brazilian phones) → Setup in under 30 minutes → Real-time menu updates via admin dashboard → No app cost Simple problem. Simple fix.

records.name: Kittine language
records.tagline: #Compiler #programming #rust
records.description: Kittine (pronounced "kitten") is a modern programming language currently under development, designed with a simple goal: Make software development more enjoyable without sacrificing performance, reliability, or scalability. Rather than being just another language, Kittine is being developed as a complete ecosystem where the language, tooling, documentation, and developer experience are designed to work together.

records.name: Loomy
records.tagline: #design #aidesign
records.description: skip the photo shoot. loomy is a private AI studio tuned to your catalog — generate clean, catalog-ready shots of every product, any angle, edit on the fly. no per-image fees.

records.name: QuatCrypto
records.tagline: Digital Products, Creator Economy, Web3, AI, SaaS
records.description: QuatCrypto is a digital product marketplace built for creators. Creators can showcase and sell digital products and services, including AI tools, SaaS, software, templates, and digital resources. We are building a global ecosystem where creators can reach users, manage digital delivery, and explore new sales channels. Currently in the early stage, we are looking for the first creators and community partners to help shape the future of digital commerce.

records.name: Kontur
records.tagline: A brutalist CLI for high-efficiency agentic pair programming
records.description: KONTUR (kohn-toor) is a terminal-native workstation where two engineers jointly supervise a fleet of coding agents on the same codebase. One hosts the agents, one joins to co-sign; both review. Every change an agent makes is gated behind two independent human approvals before it can merge, and the whole session leaves a signed, tamper-evident audit trail.

records.name: Conversion Killer
records.tagline: Your landing page has a leak. This finds it.
records.description: Paste your landing page URL and get a free conversion audit in under a minute. See your score out of 100, what's genuinely working, and what's quietly costing you sales — with the exact buyer psychology behind every finding. By Eiran Trethowan, SOLO:BOARDROOM.

records.name: Priodemy
records.tagline: One Ecosystem, Endless Possibilities.
records.description: Priodemy is an AI-powered learning ecosystem where you don't just watch courses—you build real projects. Learn with structured roadmaps, practice in an interactive coding playground, test your skills through assessments, earn certifications, and track your progress in one place. Our mission is simple: help learners move from learning to building, launching, and growing with practical, project-based education instead of passive content.

records.name: Fixworthy
records.tagline: Should you repair it or replace it? Get an honest answer.
records.description: Every source of repair advice is compromised. Retailers want you to replace. Repair shops want you to repair. Fixworthy has no stake in the outcome. Describe what's broken in plain English and Fixworthy ranks four paths: fix it yourself, hire a pro, replace it, or live with it. Almost nobody else offers that last one. The cost math is deterministic and visible. AI fills in numbers you don't know and labels them as estimates. Every input is editable. No account required. Works offline.

records.name: SIXTY
records.tagline: A 60-second daily puzzle circuit
records.description: Five quick micro-games back to back (pick the bigger expression, spot the odd one out, guess which happened first...). Score is your total time, wrong answers cost +5s. No fuss, just play. Create an account if you want to save your streak. Aim for <60 seconds

records.name: StartWithUML
records.tagline: Single Source of Truth for Software Architecture
records.description: Generate, explain, fix, and synchronize PlantUML diagrams with AI. Connect AI coding agents through MCP and keep software architecture as your single source of truth.

records.name: PeakAtlas3D
records.tagline: Explore the world's mountain peaks like never before.
records.description: PeakAtlas3D — explore the world's mountain peaks on a Mapbox globe, then open a 3D terrain profile for each summit. PeakAtlas3D combines a responsive Mapbox globe with high-fidelity, interactive 3D terrain profiles for global summits. Perfect for hikers, mountaineers, and geography geeks.

records.name: Ledger One — invoices & agreements
records.tagline: Freelance invoices + contracts in one place, $5/mo
records.description: Most freelance invoicing tools like Bonsai or HoneyBook cost $15–39/mo and pile on features solo freelancers rarely use. Ledger One does one thing well: enter your work once, and it generates a matching invoice and agreement from the same numbers — no more mismatched totals between two documents. Includes a clean invoice PDF, a built-in agreement with scope, payment terms, and a late-fee clause, and one flat price: $5/mo, unlimited invoices, cancel anytime. Would love feedback on the pricing.

records.name: GreeksSurge
records.tagline: Alpha at the Gamma Flip
records.description: GreeksSurge is an educational financial publisher that provides research, analysis, and training for options traders, specifically focusing on the mechanics of the Wheel Strategy and cash-secured puts. The platform offers resources to help traders understand metrics like Delta and Theta to manage risk and execute trade ideas.

records.name: Serious Notification
records.tagline: Speaks your Important Notifications Aloud - Keyword Filtered
records.description: Never miss urgent alerts while staying in focus. Speaks browser notifications aloud, filtered by keyword. Hands-free. No sign-up. Most notifications are not worth your attention. This extension lets you set keywords — type "urgent, meeting, payment, deadline" and only notifications containing those words get spoken aloud. Everything else stays silent. Your browser becomes a voice notification reader that filters the noise and surfaces what actually matters

records.name: Fitscape
records.tagline: A real fantasy RPG, powered by you
records.description: Fitscape turns your steps, exercise, sleep, and recovery into a real fantasy RPG. Complete quests, discover rare loot, Ascend your character, explore dungeons, fight bosses, and play with friends. It welcomes every fitness level, and money never buys success in the game.

records.name: TheGameGloble - Spend Jeff Bezos Money
records.tagline: Your Game, Your Rules,
records.description: Spend Jeff Bezos' money in this interactive simulator game! Experience the thrill of spending a massive billionaire fortune. Explore luxury, wealth, and more.

records.name: The Owners Club
records.tagline: Digital vehicle logbook with verified service history
records.description: The Owners Club is a digital vehicle logbook for car owners: MOT & mileage history, workshop jobs, parts & costs, and specialist-verified service records — all in one place. Unlike forum threads or paper folders, your car’s history stays with the vehicle and can transfer to the next owner when you sell. Browse club showroom cars and build provenance buyers actually trust.

records.name: PayNudge
records.tagline: Polite invoice reminders without the awkward follow-up
records.description: PayNudge gives freelancers and small service businesses a calm invoice ledger, review-before-send reminder schedules, delivery history, and automatic stopping when an invoice is paid or paused. New invoices start paused, and a free reminder generator works without an account.

records.name: TheAmzify | Amazon Listing & A+ Designer
records.tagline: Maximize CTR and scale sales with premium graphics.
records.description: The Amzify is a premier e-commerce visual conversion design studio specializing in high-converting Amazon listings, infographics, and Premium A+ Content (EBC). We help 7-figure Amazon FBA brands maximize click-through rates (CTR) and scale sales velocity through strategic, data-driven visual asset engineering and custom storefront design layouts.

records.name: Patterns
records.tagline: Track urges, mood & exposure
records.description: Patterns is a private OCD tracker and ERP journal for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux. Track obsessions, compulsions, triggers, distress, mood, and exposure practice. No accounts, no cloud sync, no ads: your data stays on your device.

records.name: OrgChartDesk
records.tagline: Presentation-ready org charts in minutes
records.description: Most org chart tools are HR platforms that bill per employee, or diagram apps that start from a blank canvas. OrgChartDesk is chart-first: import your roster from Excel/CSV and reporting lines connect automatically, start from designed templates, color-code departments, export print-ready PNG/PDF, and share a live view-only link that opens without an account. Built for company charts and for pursuit teams that assemble a new chart per bid. Priced per editor, never per employee. Free to start.

records.name: Leafy
records.tagline: Watering schedules that actually match your plant
records.description: Leafy builds a personalized care schedule for every plant — light, pot, season and all — instead of a generic "water weekly" rule. Snap a photo to identify a species, chat with an AI botanist, and track growth over time.

records.name: Assetly
records.tagline: Your story. Your assets. Delivered securely.
records.description: Assetly organizes your financial and legacy information and releases it only to the people you choose, at exactly the right time. Add your accounts, assets, and important documents, set an inactivity trigger, and Assetly securely delivers everything to your chosen recipients if something happens to you. Zero-knowledge, end-to-end encrypted, and free to get started.

records.name: Sayella
records.tagline: AAC for nonverbal kids. Free to start, never switched off
records.description: Sayella gives nonverbal children and adults a voice: tap symbols, build sentences, and the device speaks. A complete research-based core-word board works from the first tap. Free to start, and the talking part stays free forever, offline. No lapsed subscription can ever switch off a voice. Premium adds cloud sync, five child profiles, therapist team access and AI symbol generation, up to a one-off lifetime licence. Incumbents charge many times more. iPhone and iPad today, web and Android next.

records.name: Elephant Bamboo
records.tagline: Free book: real engineering fundamentals for the AI era
records.description: The Confident Learner is a free 23-chapter book on the tech and domain fundamentals every engineering student needs — how machines, networks, and data actually work, plus how real domains like fintech and healthcare function. Written for the AI era: AI can write code, but only you can judge if it's right. Sign in with Google, no payment, ever.

records.name: Factory Nexus by TynHub
records.tagline: Ai and swarm agents
records.description: AI coding agent platform: describe a feature and up to 5 parallel AI agents build it on isolated git branches, pass AI code review, and ship PR-ready code to GitHub.

records.name: PixDream AI
records.tagline: Complete AI studio for video, images, audio & custom models
records.description: PixDream is a complete AI creative studio available in English, Spanish, and Finnish. Generate HD videos, edit images, and create music from text. Our seamless Studio Library lets you save creations and iterate instantly—like generating a bear and easily adding a sweater to it later. Upgrade to train your own custom AI model and put yourself in any photo or video. From upscaling to an affiliate program, PixDream has everything creators need. Get 150 free credits when you sign up!

records.name: Trigr.xyz
records.tagline: Build, backtest and automate trading strategies with AI
records.description: Trigr is an AI native platform for building, backtesting, sharing, and automating trading strategies. Turn an idea into a complete strategy, test it on historical data, deploy it to live markets, or discover strategies created by other traders.

records.name: FuaHub
records.tagline: 230+ free online tools. Zero uploads, zero tracking.
records.description: FuaHub is a privacy-first web toolkit featuring 230+ online tools for PDF, images, text, and code. Unlike traditional tools that upload files to servers, FuaHub processes everything 100% locally in your browser using WebAssembly and Canvas API. Your files never leave your device. Features include PDF merge/split, image compression, HEIC to JPG, JSON formatter, and UUID generator. Fast, free, and works offline.

records.name: Link in Bio by MumenLabs
records.tagline: The link in bio built to rank on Google, from ~$5/mo
records.description: A link in bio built to rank on Google with real SEO, free per-link analytics, email capture, and a QR code. Free to build, about $5/month while live, and zero commission on your sales.

records.name: Notering
records.tagline: Gaming news without the noise: cross-checked and labeled
records.description: Notering is a minimalist gaming news app. Every story is cross-checked against multiple sources (all linked), rumors always get a clear RUMOR badge, and the writing stays neutral: no clickbait, no hot takes. One curated daily edition instead of an endless feed. Follow games or whole franchises for release reminders, price drop alerts and free game alerts. Built by a solo dev from Brazil with Flutter, Supabase and Netlify. Free on Google Play, plus a web version.

records.name: OpenChatCut
records.tagline: Open-source AI agent video editor with a real timeline
records.description: OpenChatCut is an open-source ChatCut alternative: local-first AI video editing where Codex, Claude, and MCP agents work on a real multitrack timeline. Free, editable exports, AGPL.

records.name: LeadGuide
records.tagline: Sales Copilot built for authentic relationships, not spam.
records.description: Most AI SDRs are built to blast thousands of cold emails. That's not sales. That's spam. LeadGuide is built for quality, not quantity. It finds qualified leads, researches prospects, builds sales briefs, recommends the best next step, and helps you write personalized outreach in your own voice. AI does the prep - you stay in control. Built for founders and small teams who want better conversations, not more spam.

records.name: Living Page
records.tagline: White-label PDF flipbooks built for agencies and freelancers
records.description: PDFs are a terrible way to share documents. Living Page converts them into interactive flipbooks with embeds, analytics, and white-label workspaces for agencies and freelancers. No ads, no page caps. Free to try. Sending a PDF is like shouting into a void. Living Page flips it - see who opened your flipbook, which pages got attention, and where they dropped off. Know before you follow up. We'll nudge you with read receipts.

records.name: Recall 9
records.tagline: Your AI-powered second brain app
records.description: Recall 9 is a simple place to save everything you don't want to forget but with the added power of AI. Whenever you come across something interesting, just send it to Recall 9. It could be a watch you found on Instagram, an article you want to read later, a shopping list, or even a quick voice note when an idea pops into your head. Recall 9's AI searches through your notes, links, voice recordings, images, and everything else you've saved, so you can find what you're looking for in seconds.

records.name: GetMint
records.tagline: Turn AI search into a growth channel
records.description: Search is moving from Google to AI. When people ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity for a recommendation, is your brand in the answer? GetMint runs the full loop: track how AI models mention and recommend your brand, get prioritized actions from an AI agent and our experts, then publish the content that gets you mentioned. Used by L'Oréal, Accor, Lacoste and 200+ brands. Start free: one brand, 10 prompts, no credit card.

records.name: WunaTalk
records.tagline: Practice speaking English out loud with an AI voice tutor
records.description: WunaTalk is a voice-first AI English tutor in your browser — no app, no install. You talk out loud; the AI listens, replies by voice and gently corrects your mistakes. Pick a character and a real-life scenario — job interview, ordering food, travel, small talk — and just start talking. Every conversation improvises differently. Free: 3 min of real conversation daily, forever. Premium: much more talk time. Built for people who understand English but freeze when speaking.

records.name: SciSuite
